events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Liam Gallagher, known as the frontman of Oasis and for his solo career, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: The iconic voice of a generation, Liam Gallagher, is 54 today. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975, becoming one of his most influential works.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since the UK single release of John Lennon's 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple first unveiled the iPod in October 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket' and revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Tech Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod, first revealed 25 years ago this month, changed how we listened to music forever. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit screens, the world's most famous secret agent still captivates. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: Born on this day in 1940, John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Today, we remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python and co-creator of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: From silly walks to hotel mayhem, the brilliant John Cleese turns 87 today! What's your favourite moment from the comedy icon?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing the band's diverse musical styles.

angles.name: Double Album Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago this month, The Beatles unleashed their sprawling 'White Album'. A masterpiece of eclecticism – what are your standout tracks?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring tracks like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Evolutionary Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant evolution in their sound. A true classic.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot in New York City on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His vision for peace and his timeless music continue to resonate globally.
